name: modeler
description: Model-based development of Next.js + Supabase apps driven by a domain metamodel in Ecore notation (domain.ecore.yaml): metamodel from the prompt or reverse-engineered from the database, a web modeler that becomes part of the application (admin page, proposals, vendored CLI with model:* npm scripts), drift checks between metamodel and database, Ecore/Emfatic/Mermaid export.
